title: Football Data Platform — Data Quality
description: Read-only PostgreSQL DQ evidence. Current panels = latest FULL execution, independent of time/detail filters. History panels = all persisted scopes in selected time range. Grafana does not run DQ; Airflow owns task operations, Superset owns football BI.

list.name: competition
list.label: Competition
list.query: SELECT 'Competition '||competition_id AS __text,competition_id::text AS __value FROM observability.dq_current_executions ORDER BY competition_id
list.definition: SELECT 'Competition '||competition_id AS __text,competition_id::text AS __value FROM observability.dq_current_executions ORDER BY competition_id

list.name: season
list.label: Season
list.query: SELECT 'Season '||season_id AS __text,season_id::text AS __value FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} ORDER BY season_id
list.definition: SELECT 'Season '||season_id AS __text,season_id::text AS __value FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} ORDER BY season_id

list.name: layer
list.label: Layer
list.query: SELECT __text,__value FROM (SELECT 'All' AS __text,'__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT layer AS __text,layer AS __value FROM observability.dq_rule_history WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}) choices ORDER BY (__value <> '__all'),__value
list.definition: SELECT __text,__value FROM (SELECT 'All' AS __text,'__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT layer AS __text,layer AS __value FROM observability.dq_rule_history WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}) choices ORDER BY (__value <> '__all'),__value

panels.title: Current full DQ status
panels.description: Latest full execution, including failures. Independent of time range and detail filters. PASS may include intentional SKIPs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}

panels.title: PASS · current full
panels.description: All rules in the latest FULL execution; not summed history or filtered rules.

targets.rawSql: SELECT passed FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}

panels.title: FAIL · current full
panels.description: All rules in the latest FULL execution; not summed history or filtered rules.

targets.rawSql: SELECT failed FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}

panels.title: WARN · current full
panels.description: All rules in the latest FULL execution; not summed history or filtered rules.

targets.rawSql: SELECT warnings FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}

panels.title: SKIP · current full
panels.description: All rules in the latest FULL execution; not summed history or filtered rules.

targets.rawSql: SELECT skipped FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}

panels.title: Last full DQ execution
panels.description: Factual timestamp; on-demand runs have no daily freshness SLA.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM finished_at)*1000 AS last_execution FROM observability.dq_current_executions WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}

panels.title: Current quality by layer
panels.description: All rules in latest FULL execution. Bronze, Silver, Gold, serving and API use the persisted layer taxonomy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT layer, count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='PASS') AS "PASS", count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='FAIL') AS "FAIL", count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='WARN') AS "WARN", count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='SKIP') AS "SKIP" FROM observability.dq_current_results WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring} GROUP BY layer ORDER BY layer

panels.title: All contexts · latest full health
panels.description: Always all persisted FULL contexts, independent of selectors/time range. Partial runs never replace current full health.

targets.rawSql: SELECT competition_id,season_id,finished_at,status,passed AS "PASS",failed AS "FAIL",warnings AS "WARN",skipped AS "SKIP" FROM observability.dq_current_executions ORDER BY competition_id,season_id

panels.title: Recent non-PASS results · history
panels.description: Append-only history in the selected time range. Intentional SKIPs remain visible, distinct from failures. Only sanitized Stage 7A messages.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT checked_at,competition_id,season_id,suite,layer,dataset,rule_id,status,severity,message FROM observability.dq_rule_history WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}
  AND (${layer:sqlstring} = '__all' OR layer = ${layer:sqlstring})
  AND (${dataset:sqlstring} = '__all' OR dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__all' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${status:sqlstring} = '__all' OR status = ${status:sqlstring})
  AND (${rule_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR rule_id = ${rule_id:sqlstring}) AND status <> 'PASS' ORDER BY checked_at DESC,execution_id DESC,rule_id LIMIT 100

panels.title: Rule detail · history
panels.description: Filter Rule ID or click a rule in the non-PASS table. Numeric/boolean/null observations retain their real meaning; no invented numeric PASS values.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT checked_at,suite,rule_id,layer,dataset,status,severity,observed::text AS observed,expected::text AS expected,message,build_id,execution_id FROM observability.dq_rule_history WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}
  AND (${layer:sqlstring} = '__all' OR layer = ${layer:sqlstring})
  AND (${dataset:sqlstring} = '__all' OR dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__all' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${status:sqlstring} = '__all' OR status = ${status:sqlstring})
  AND (${rule_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR rule_id = ${rule_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY checked_at DESC,execution_id DESC,rule_id LIMIT 500

panels.title: Dataset / build traceability · current full
panels.description: Build identity is traceability, not the main label. Last full execution results, detail filters apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT layer,dataset,build_id,max(checked_at) AS checked_at,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='PASS') AS "PASS",count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='FAIL') AS "FAIL",count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='WARN') AS "WARN",count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='SKIP') AS "SKIP" FROM observability.dq_current_results WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}
  AND (${layer:sqlstring} = '__all' OR layer = ${layer:sqlstring})
  AND (${dataset:sqlstring} = '__all' OR dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__all' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${status:sqlstring} = '__all' OR status = ${status:sqlstring})
  AND (${rule_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR rule_id = ${rule_id:sqlstring}) AND build_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY layer,dataset,build_id ORDER BY layer,dataset LIMIT 200

panels.title: DQ executions · history (all scopes)
panels.description: Each row is an actual execution, including partial scopes. No daily cadence or gap-is-failure assumption. Rule-level detail filters do not change execution counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT finished_at,suite,status,total_checks,passed AS "PASS",failed AS "FAIL",warnings AS "WARN",skipped AS "SKIP",airflow_dag_id,airflow_task_id,execution_id FROM observability.dq_execution_history WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at) AND competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring} ORDER BY finished_at DESC,execution_id DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Recorded volumes / xG · history
panels.description: Only actual persisted volume/xG observations. Values from different rules have different units: use Rule ID to isolate one metric. Informational, no anomaly thresholds. SQL NULL stays missing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT checked_at AS "time",numeric_observed AS value,rule_id AS metric FROM observability.dq_rule_history WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}
  AND (${layer:sqlstring} = '__all' OR layer = ${layer:sqlstring})
  AND (${dataset:sqlstring} = '__all' OR dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__all' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${status:sqlstring} = '__all' OR status = ${status:sqlstring})
  AND (${rule_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR rule_id = ${rule_id:sqlstring}) AND numeric_observed IS NOT NULL AND rule_id ~ '(row_count|match_count|shot_count|event_count|team_shot_xg)$' ORDER BY checked_at,rule_id LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Build / load observations · current full
panels.description: Factual registered build/load timestamps observed by Stage 7A, not an inferred SLA or stale classification.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT layer,dataset,rule_id,build_id,to_timestamp(numeric_observed::double precision) AS registered_at,checked_at FROM observability.dq_current_results WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring}
  AND (${layer:sqlstring} = '__all' OR layer = ${layer:sqlstring})
  AND (${dataset:sqlstring} = '__all' OR dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring})
  AND (${severity:sqlstring} = '__all' OR severity = ${severity:sqlstring})
  AND (${status:sqlstring} = '__all' OR status = ${status:sqlstring})
  AND (${rule_id:sqlstring} = '__all' OR rule_id = ${rule_id:sqlstring}) AND status='PASS' AND numeric_observed IS NOT NULL AND rule_id ~ '(build_timestamp|load_timestamp)$' ORDER BY layer,dataset,rule_id LIMIT 200

panels.title: Last successful full DQ
panels.description: Last successful full execution, separate from latest health. PASS can contain intentional SKIPs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(finished_at))*1000 AS last_success FROM observability.dq_execution_history WHERE competition_id = ${competition:sqlstring} AND season_id = ${season:sqlstring} AND suite='full' AND status='PASS'
